# Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - January 7, 2025

> 日期: 2025-01-07 · 站点: en · 来源: https://overwatch.blizzard.com/en-us/news/patch-notes/live/2025/01

## Hotfix Balance Update

This is a hero balance hotfix. Replay codes from the December 19, 2024 patch are still available.

## Hero Balance Updates

These hero balance updates only apply to our standard game modes and not the 6v6 Experiment.

## Tank（重装）

### Hazard（重装）

#### Spike Guard
- Damage reduction is reduced from 75% to 65%.
- Duration reduced from 3.5 to 3 seconds.

## Damage（输出）

### Sojourn（输出）

#### Railgun
- Time before energy degeneration begins decreased from 12 to 9 seconds.

### Widowmaker（输出）

#### Widow's Kiss
- Scoped shots no longer benefit from global projectile size increases.
